notes: MNN-Pocket-0.3B_int8_ekv2048.litertlm of litert-community/MNN-Pocket-0.3B: taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM with a 2,048-token KV cache; the same weights and graph as MNN-Pocket-0.3B_int8.litertlm, only the KV-sized inputs and three shape constants differ. Added 2026-11-07 (Hub commit 475036b0); main 6ea52447 at the read, 320025488 B, sha256 3d4710d406870fd0a65169503851335256445580999f56a9c219da0e51e49315. Measured 2026-11-06 / 07 in the runs r8 (phones and the Mac GSM8K) and r10 (Mac speed) on these bytes.
quantization: int8 weights (one scale per output channel, dynamic_wi8_afp32) with float activations, fp16 activations on the GPU (no activation type declared); KV cache 2,048 tokens; prefill signatures 128 and 1,024; attention composites (odml.qkv_norm_rope, odml.sdpa_transposed); model type generic_model
